```{r setup, include=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(ape)
library(MASS)
library(glmmTMB)
library(dplyr)   
source('../R/getData_current.R')
source('../R/MeanAbund.R')
source('../R/U_current.R')
source('../R/fit_model_current2.R')
source('../R/get_num.eig.R')
load('../data/Para_PCV.RData')

find_npd_seed <- function(first_seed = 1L, max_attempts = 1000L) {
  target <- "Model convergence problem; non-positive-definite Hessian matrix"
  J <- diag(p) - matrix(1 / p, p, p)

  for (i in seq_len(max_attempts)) {
    seed_i <- first_seed + i - 1L
    set.seed(seed_i)

    # Subsample and matrices: redo these for every seed
    Subsample <- sample(TruePara, p)
    subtree <- keep.tip(tree, names(Subsample))
    DM <- cophenetic.phylo(subtree)
    S <- max(DM) - DM
    S_J <- J %*% S %*% J

    eig <- eigen(S_J)
    val_num.eig <- get_num.eig(
      Methods = "Method3",
      Methods_para = NA,
      D = diag(eig$values)[-p, -p]
    )

    # Data generation
    sim_data <- getData(
      DM_phy_func = DM,
      q = q,
      alpha = alpha,
      beta = beta,
      r = r,
      quantile = quantile,
      Eigen = Eigen,
      Distribution = fam_type,
      p = p,
      Absence = TRUE,
      Subsample = Subsample,
      FactorLoading = FactorLoading,
      NOS = NOPS
    )

    # Modelling
    seen_warnings <- character()

    Model <- withCallingHandlers(
      fit_model(
        type = "p_mid",
        matrix_type = "P_J",
        rr = TRUE,
        LV_num = 2,
        yX = sim_data$yX,
        P_J = eig$vectors,
        val_num.eig = val_num.eig,
        Distribution = fam_type,
        null = FALSE,
        p = p,
        site = FALSE
      ),
      warning = function(w) {
        seen_warnings <<- c(seen_warnings, conditionMessage(w))
      }
    )

    # fit_model() may capture/muffle warnings internally, so check both
    # its returned messages and the fitted model's Hessian status.
    messages <- unique(c(seen_warnings, Model$warning_msgs))

    found <- any(grepl(target, messages, fixed = TRUE)) ||
      isFALSE(Model$pdHess)

    if (found) {
      message("Found at seed ", seed_i, " (attempt ", i, ")")

      return(list(
        seed = seed_i,
        attempt = i,
        warnings = messages,
        Subsample = Subsample,
        DM = DM,
        S_J = S_J,
        data = sim_data,
        Model = Model
      ))
    }
  }

  stop("No non-positive-definite Hessian found in ",
       max_attempts, " attempts.")
}
```

# Parameters
```{r}
set.seed(1)
p <- 10
NOPS <- 2# Number of pair of swaps 
r <- 64
q <- 5
alpha <- log(9 / 4)
beta <- log(4)

Subsample <- sample(TruePara, p)
subtree <- keep.tip(tree, names(Subsample))
DM <- cophenetic.phylo(subtree)
S <- max(DM) - DM
J <- diag(1, p) - (1/p) * matrix(1, p, p)
S_J <- J %*% S %*% J

quantile <- 0.35
Eigen <- 3
fam_type <- 'binomial'
Absence <- 'TRUE'
FactorLoading <- Lambda
val_num.eig <- get_num.eig(Methods = 'Method3', 
                           Methods_para = NA,
                           D = diag(eigen(S_J)$values)[-p, -p])
```

# Data set searching for modelling warning
```{r}
result <- find_npd_seed(first_seed = 1L, max_attempts = 1000L)
result$seed
```

# Data Generation

```{r cars}
# data <- getData(DM_phy_func = DM, q = q, alpha = alpha, beta = beta,

#                 Distribution = fam_type, p = p,
#                      Absence = TRUE, Subsample = Subsample,
#                 FactorLoading = FactorLoading, NOS = NOPS)

data <- result$data
data$yX %>%
  dplyr::group_by(com) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n = dplyr::n(),
    presences = sum(y),
    prevalence = mean(y),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

xtabs(y ~ com + sp, data = data$yX)
```

# Modelling
```{r}
Model <- fit_model(type = 'p_mid', matrix_type = 'P_J', rr = TRUE, LV_num = 2,
                      yX = data$yX, P_J = eigen(S_J)$vectors, 
                      val_num.eig = val_num.eig, Distribution = fam_type, 
                      null = FALSE, p = p, site = FALSE)
```


# Model fixing by change optimizer
```{r}
K_names <- paste0("p", (val_num.eig + 1):p)
K <- diag(length(K_names))
dimnames(K) <- list(K_names, K_names)

# Try a different optimizer
Model_optim <- update(Model$fit,
                      family = stats::binomial(link = "logit"),
                      data = Model$fit$frame,
                              control=glmmTMBControl(optimizer=optim,
                                                     optArgs=list(method="BFGS")))

p1 <- Model$fit$fit$par
p2 <- Model_optim$fit$par

stopifnot(identical(names(p1), names(p2)))

parameter_comparison <- data.frame(
  component = names(p1),
  index = ave(seq_along(p1), names(p1), FUN = seq_along),
  nlminb = unname(p1),
  optim = unname(p2),
  difference = unname(p2 - p1)
)

print(parameter_comparison, row.names = FALSE)

ModelComparison_optimizer<- data.frame(
  fit = c("nlminb", "optim"),
  objective = c(
    Model$fit$fit$objective,
    Model_optim$fit$objective
  ),
  convergence = c(
    Model$convergence,
    Model_optim$fit$convergence
  ),
  pdHess = c(
    Model$pdHess,
    Model_optim$sdr$pdHess
  )
)
print(ModelComparison_optimizer)
```

# Model fixing by changing starting values
```{r}
# Try a different starting value
start_opt <- Model_optim$obj$env$parList(
  Model_optim$fit$par,
  Model_optim$fit$parfull
)

start_opt <- start_opt[lengths(start_opt) > 0]

fit_formula <- formula(Model_optim)
environment(fit_formula) <- environment()  # makes the current K available

Model_restart <- update(
  Model_optim,
  formula = fit_formula,
  data = Model_optim$frame,
  family = binomial(link = "logit"),
  start = start_opt,
  control = glmmTMBControl(
    optimizer = optim,
    optArgs = list(method = "BFGS")
  )
)

p3 <- Model_optim$fit$par
p4 <- Model_restart$fit$par

stopifnot(identical(names(p3), names(p4)))

parameter_comparison_restart <- data.frame(
  component = names(p3),
  index = ave(seq_along(p3), names(p3), FUN = seq_along),
  BFGS = unname(p3),
  BFGS_restart = unname(p4),
  difference = unname(p4 - p3)
)

print(parameter_comparison_restart, row.names = FALSE)

ModelComparison_restart <- data.frame(
  fit = c("BFGS", "BFGS restart"),
  objective = c(
    Model_optim$fit$objective,
    Model_restart$fit$objective
  ),
  convergence = c(
    Model_optim$fit$convergence,
    Model_restart$fit$convergence
  ),
  pdHess = c(
    Model_optim$sdr$pdHess,
    Model_restart$sdr$pdHess
  )
)

print(ModelComparison_restart)

```
